author: Inside Edition
description: A mom was in the throes of giving birth in her garage. Fortunately, her husband was there to deliver the baby. Their other kids looked on as the event unfolded in the family's driveway. Husband Damien Mahone, who is a deputy sheriff, was at work when he checked his home surveillance camera and saw what was happening. His wife Christina's water had broken. Damien rushed home and helped deliver the baby. New baby Scotti joined sister Merci and brother Xander.
title: Husband Helps Wife Deliver Baby In Family's Driveway

author: Inside Edition
description: A woman gave birth to a baby girl and she and her husband quickly realized the baby was a different race and looked nothing like them. Genetic testing confirmed that Baby Shea, who was conceived via IVF, is 100% South Asian. The clinic reportedly admitted they mistakenly implanted Tiffany Score with someone else's embryo. Tiffany Score and her husband Steven Mills announced they will retain custody of Shea and that they will allow her biological parents to be part of her life.
title: Woman Gives Birth To Baby Not Biologically Hers In IVF Embryo Mix-Up

author: Inside Edition
description: Here's a reason to check your toilet in between uses. A snake was waiting for the next person to use the loo and surely made them want to hold it until further notice. Turkish media says a man happened to find the snake in his toilet bowl and immediately called emergency services. Firefighters were dispatched to deal with the unwanted guest. It's unknown if the snake was dangerous, but it was best not to take chances. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Snake Found In Toilet Bowl Removed By Firefighters

author: Inside Edition
description: A shakeup in world politics as the Prime Minister of Great Britain, Keir Starmer, resigned. Just two years after winning election in a landslide, Starmer has reportedly lost the confidence of his Labour Party. Faced with a challenge to his leadership, Starmer said he would resign and make way for a new Prime Minister, who will be tasked with trying to control the chaotic political climate in the country. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer Resigns

author: Inside Edition
description: The Red Hook Pinball Museum in Brooklyn, New York's Red Hook neighborhood boasts nearly two dozen analog pinball machines from the 1930s to the 1970s.
title: 'There's No Circuit Boards, No Microprocessors, No Transistors' #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Like many pet owners, Robert and Karen Fandre are pretty fond of their sweet dog Lillie Ann. Not only is she a great companion, she helps alert Robert when he's having health complications. Recently, Lillie Ann's ability to help reached beyond their home. They told WSAW that Lillie Ann found the neighbor stuck on the floor, injured and needing assistance. And it possibly saved their life. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Wisconsin Dog Helps Neighbor Having A Medical Emergency
